items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Buddy is the only one, and then now Eddie Daniels, who is sensational. You know he’s just — it’s nice talking about him because he’s so fantastic.

ctx.x: Buddy DeFranco was about the only one.

Buddy is the only one, and then now Eddie Daniels, who is sensational. You know he’s just — it’s nice talking about him because he’s so fantastic. But I still like to try to swing the way Benny, Artie, both of them, had that pulse which very few people do nowadays. So I’m hoping as long as I last I’m going to try to swing.
Yeah. Well there’s a certain amount of swing revival going on right now.
